title: MEXT Scholarship (Embassy Recommendation)
provider: Government of Japan (Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology)
description: Japan's flagship government scholarship, offered through Japanese embassies and consulates for undergraduate, research (master's/doctoral), specialised training and other categories. Includes tuition, a monthly stipend and round-trip airfare.
amount: Full tuition, monthly stipend (~JPY 117,000-145,000), round-trip airfare

title: MEXT Scholarship (University Recommendation)
provider: Government of Japan (Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology)
description: MEXT scholarship route in which a Japanese university nominates prospective or current international research students directly to MEXT, typically after the student has secured a prospective supervisor.
amount: Full tuition, monthly stipend (~JPY 143,000-145,000), round-trip airfare

title: JASSO Monbukagakusho Honors Scholarship
description: Monthly living-support scholarship for privately financed international students already enrolled at a Japanese university or Japanese-language institution, awarded on the basis of academic performance and financial need.
amount: JPY 48,000 per month (JPY 30,000 for Japanese-language students)

title: ADB-Japan Scholarship Program (ADB-JSP)
provider: Asian Development Bank / Government of Japan
field: Economics, management, science and technology, development studies
description: Scholarships for citizens of ADB's developing member countries to pursue postgraduate study at designated institutions in the Asia-Pacific region, several of which are in Japan.
amount: Full tuition, monthly living and housing allowance, books, insurance, airfare

title: Japan-IMF Scholarship Program for Asia (JISPA)
provider: International Monetary Fund / Government of Japan
field: Macroeconomics, economic policy, public finance, monetary policy
description: Scholarships for junior government officials from eligible Asia-Pacific countries to pursue a master's degree in macroeconomics or a related field at partner universities in Japan, aimed at building capacity for economic policymaking.
amount: Full tuition, living and housing allowance, insurance, airfare, study materials

title: University of Tokyo Fellowship (UTokyo Fellowship)
description: Institutional fellowship providing a monthly living stipend and, for many graduate schools, tuition support to outstanding incoming graduate students. Administered by each graduate school as part of admissions.
amount: Monthly stipend (JPY 150,000-180,000) plus tuition support in many programmes

title: Honjo International Scholarship Foundation Scholarship
description: Living-support scholarship for privately financed international students enrolled or planning to enrol in a graduate degree programme at a Japanese university, selected on academic ability, character and future contribution.
amount: JPY 200,000 per month (up to JPY 180,000 for some categories)
